claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Migrating a markdown-with-frontmatter corpus into cairn concepts is done by a short script.
Precondition pointer to the adapter page.
Cairn ships no importer; migration is a mapping problem solved with a short script.
Section heading.
parseMarkdown splits frontmatter from body using the same parser as the save path.
Snippet reading an old file with parseMarkdown.
Frontmatter is claimed to be exactly what the old YAML block held.
Body is everything after the frontmatter block.
The step assumes nothing about the old generator.
Mapping the frontmatter is the real work and depends on the old generator.
A date field expects YYYY-MM-DD while a datetime field keeps the full ISO string.
Tag values should be lowercase and consistent when a tag vocabulary is configured.
Draft flags map onto a draft state the admin controls, not a frontmatter key.
Draft state lives in the entry itself.
A migrated entry should stay a draft pending editorial review.
Cairn translates no shortcodes or includes automatically.
Rebuild each shortcode as a registered component, then find and replace in bodies.
Snippet mapping old frontmatter fields to new ones.
Section heading.
An entry id is its filename stem, its only identity.
The permalink slug derives from the filename, with the date prefix stripped for a dated concept.
A rename after import rewrites inbound references; nothing rewrites external links.
Only a prefix at the declared datePrefix granularity is stripped; extra date digits stay in the slug.
A filename outside the id shape still serves but is invisible to cairn: links and the guards.
serializeMarkdown is not public; a script writes the frontmatter block directly.
Snippet writing a migrated file with a YAML library.
Any YAML library works if the output is a frontmatter block parseMarkdown can read.
Section heading.
Cairn has no bulk media importer; an old image URL renders unchanged.
Adopting a picture into the media library is optional and one asset at a time.
Section heading.
Migrated files are checked by the concept validator.
Opening each migrated entry in the admin shows an invalid field error inline.
A migrated entry is expected to open in the admin editor with no validation errors.
